subject.title: fix(xai): Grok subscription inference fails with HTTP 426 on every request

question: Should xAI OAuth provider base-URL overrides inherit the Grok proxy’s required static client-version header, or should that header be constrained to the official Grok OAuth proxy?
rationale: The implementation fixes the official endpoint, but the supported configuration override changes the destination of the new header; tests establish the official and API-key routes, not the custom-override contract.

options.title: Constrain the header to the official proxy
options.body: Preserve custom OAuth base-URL behavior without adding a new request header to arbitrary operator-selected endpoints.

options.title: Accept forwarding to overrides
options.body: Treat any xAI OAuth base-URL override as a Grok-compatible proxy and document that it receives the required compatibility header.

recommendation.title: Constrain the header to the official proxy
recommendation.body: Preserve custom OAuth base-URL behavior without adding a new request header to arbitrary operator-selected endpoints.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor supplied the concrete endpoint-contract evidence needed to clarify the intended override behavior, though current-main ownership evidence was unavailable.
